name: portfolio-fullstack-root
description: Root scripts for managing the monorepo. No dependencies needed here.

scripts.db:up: docker-compose up -d mysql && until docker exec mysql mysqladmin ping -uroot -p12345678 --silent 2>/dev/null; do echo 'waiting for mysql...'; sleep 2; done
scripts.db:reseed: npm run db:up && docker exec -i mysql mysql --default-character-set=utf8mb4 -uroot -p12345678 -e 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS mydb; CREATE DATABASE mydb CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;' && docker exec -i mysql mysql --default-character-set=utf8mb4 -uroot -p12345678 mydb < db_fix.sql && echo '✅ db reseeded'
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../bff && npm install
scripts.wiki:dev: npm run wiki:sync && cd wiki && npm run start
scripts.wiki:dev:de: npm run wiki:sync && cd wiki && npm run start -- --locale de
scripts.wiki:dev:vi: npm run wiki:sync && cd wiki && npm run start -- --locale vi
scripts.wiki:build: npm run wiki:sync && cd wiki && npm run build
